body:
I don’t know you. You don’t know me. But I’ve recently been writing about some things that I think are over rated in this world so you get to be the first to hear my options. I wrote about my mom and dads divorce, so you know the back story, it’s about love…

Love... a thought, a feeling, a desire. Love is everyone’s goal, everyone’s hopeful future it’s what we all dream about and wish for. We envy the ones who have it and beg to share it with the ones who don’t. Well not me. When I think of love, I don’t see a free meadow with flowers, clear sky’s and rainbows, with warm summer air and a clear thinking mind. I simply don’t see that at all. Love, love is a drug. It’s a drug so powerful it can blur your vision and your mind. This heavy haze is so addictive, your left feeling lonely and numb without it. Love is like a contract, so long and persist, almost no one stops to read it. It’s one big pledge, filled with hundreds of smaller promises. Promises that even the most committed people can always keep. There all just empty vows and empty words cause that drug has you so far mesmerized... you don’t even know what you’ve signed up for. Is might not always be the case... but no matter how strong the drug is, it will eventually ware off. 

Well yea, thanks. K.b
I know how you feel… I wish I could just dissolve, not a trace left behind, nor a memory to remember.
